Festivals, construction sites, and off-grid locations used to run on roaring diesel generators. Then Greener Power Solutions arrived: a provider of large zero-emission mobile batteries, now Europe's market leader in mobile battery rental, backed by a top tier PE firm. As it scales fast across Europe, the Operations Manager builds the engine that keeps this round-the-clock business running. 
 Amsterdam 
 31 aug 2026 
 Greener Power Solutions 
The idea was born backstage at a festival, where the founders were struck by how much diesel it took to keep the lights on. Greener Power Solutions set out to change that, renting out mobile batteries that deliver clean, quiet power exactly where the grid falls short: festivals, construction sites, film sets, and infrastructure projects. Its self-developed software sets the batteries apart, giving customers real insight into their energy use and steering different sources into one efficient supply. And the market keeps growing. In the Netherlands alone, nearly 10,000 businesses are waiting for electrification. 
What began as a bold alternative to the diesel generator has become the clear market leader. Greener has doubled its revenue and EBITDA every year since its founding in 2018. Since infrastructure investor CVC DIF came on board in 2022, that pace has only accelerated: the fleet has grown from 40 batteries to 300, the team from 20 to 90 people. Greener now operates across the Netherlands, the UK, Spain, France, DACH and the Nordics and Sweden, and with other regions in sight. 
That kind of growth changes what an organization needs. In September 2025, Jasper van den Driest joined as CEO to lead the next phase: the shift from a fast-moving scale-up into a mature, professional company. The commercial engine runs well.
